name: Jishbuh
title: Descendants of Asher
summary: Jishbuh was a man from the tribe of Asher in Israel, mentioned in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Beriah and belonged to one of the prominent families within the tribe of Asher. He is primarily known through genealogical lists that describe the descendants of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Jishbuh is listed as one of the sons of Beriah in the genealogy of the descendants of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Asher and Its Family Heads
keyEvents.description: Jishbuh belonged to the family heads in the tribe of Asher who were recorded as skilled warriors and leaders.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Beriah
keyEvents.description: Beriah, Jishbuh's father, was a prominent figure among the descendants of Asher, and his sons were counted among the leading men of the tribe.

keyEvents.title: Asher's Blessing and Inheritance
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher, to which Ishbah belonged, received blessings from Jacob and Moses promising prosperity and strength.
